## Summary

Briefly describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Linked Issues

Closes #<issue-number> (if applicable).

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)

## Testing

- [ ] Backend: `cd backend && pytest` passes
- [ ] Frontend: `cd frontend && npm run test -- --run` passes
- [ ] Frontend: `cd frontend && npm run build` passes
- [ ] Manual testing steps performed

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commits used for commit messages
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, CONTRIBUTING, API reference)
- [ ] Wellness disclaimer preserved on any new recommendation surfaces
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed

## Screenshots / Demos

Attach screenshots or a short demo if the change affects the UI.
